items.title: No Rash Actions: a long list of don'ts
items.where: No Rash Actions: Visions Are Not Commands, P3
items.your_version: Until you have slept and eaten, maybe don't drive, travel, break up, make up, quit your job, confess everything, confront or accuse that list of people you've been meaning to... Think twice before sending whatever ridiculous message you're planning on to Judge Amos, posting that revelation you'll forget tomorrow, giving away your BMW, buying a new BMW. After you decide that you are permanently enlightened or permanently damaged, and you explained the whole universe to your parents in 42 seconds, you can still change your mind the next day.
items.comment: high conf human on first try. seems like you didn't even try to make it less like a massive robotic compressed list. https://www.pangram.com/history/e1537940-bdb9-4b2e-9220-141df65fb47a?ucc=AyfvimuzkWB&utm_source=pangram_share&utm_medium=copy_link
items.my_version: Until you have slept and eaten, don't drive, travel, break up, quit your job, confess everything, confront anybody, accuse anybody, send the message, post the revelation, give away possessions, make a grand purchase, call your ex, call your parents to explain the universe, or decide that you are permanently enlightened or permanently damaged.
